Context: 3. Reservation for Economically Weaker Sections (EWSs)

4. the notified municipalities.
4. Family includes.A person who seeks benefit of reservation, his/her parents and siblings below the age of 18 years as also his/her spouse and children below the age of 18 years.
5. Certificate.The benefit of reservation under EWS can be availed upon production of an Income and Asset Certificate issued by the prescribed Authority. The Officer who issues the certificate should verify all relevant documents following due process as prescribed by the respective State/ UT.
